issues.description: Field mismatch for Person.birthday: In the template Person class the private field is declared as java.time.LocalDate (src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java), and the unit/integration tests call person.setBirthday(LocalDate...) expecting a LocalDate. In the solution Person class the private field is declared as String while the getter and setter signatures use java.time.LocalDate. This inconsistency (field type String vs. accessors and tests using LocalDate) will cause compilation errors and prevents students from running or adapting the provided tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the birthday attribute type consistent across repository, solution, and tests. Preferred fix: in the solution Person class change the field declaration from private String birthday; to private java.time.LocalDate birthday; and ensure the import and getter/setter types remain java.time.LocalDate. Rebuild to verify compilation and update any code that assumed a String representation.
